method: All 123 existing research entries are enumerated from the canonical 102-research ledger and 21 new controversy drafts; no additional dossier or published route is created.
All 622 source-bearing blocks and 1,508 source-ID occurrences remain represented. URL format and source-ID resolution are NOT the same as quote/context certification or expert theological review.
A spot check marks only the identified primary-source passage as directly examined; no record is certified completely merely because one source passage was checked.
Source links on a named critic's own site establish the argument the critic actually advances, not the truth of factual or doctrinal assertions.
Draft EN/FR presence does not imply native-French copyediting, original-language collation or publication permission.

A later same-day tranche compared eight additional primary passages, including original 2023 five-cardinal dubia signatures: each spot check remains strictly scoped and gives no blanket record-level approval.
